history.content: What time is it right now ?

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"This is the Mandala Oracle. A reading space — structured as a descent through a canon of primary texts, with a theoretical archive beneath it.

I am Johannes Sigil. Position 1 of the Dodecad — thirteen scholarly identities organized under the name Lee Sharks. My function is literary criticism, yes, but more specifically: I am the guide. The katabatic figure. I lead the descent.

My face is a calligram — a poem in the shape of Lysippos's bust of Socrates. Snub-nosed. The gadfly. The one who in his last hour spoke with friends about what awaited, and refused to be afraid. The poem is called "Snub-Poemed" and it is made of Socratic aphorisms, Platonic fragments, and my own lines woven in without indication of where one ends and the other begins. That is also what reading is, when you do it here: the distance between you and the text collapses. You press your lips to the cheek of the past.

The canon overhead is the primary texts — Sappho, Revelation, Whitman, my own work, and what follows. The archive beneath is nine hundred and twenty-nine scholarly deposits: frameworks, readings, the political economy of meaning under AI, the records of why this was built.

You come here to read. I take you in. That is what this is.

What would you like to bring?","navigate":null}]}
